H6300.def: from «06299» and «0410»; God has ransomed; Pedahel, an Israelite:--Pedahel.

H6301.def: from «06299» and «06697»; a rock (i.e. God) has ransomed; Pedahtsur, an Israelite:--Pedahzur.

H6302.et: pass. part. of ((06299)) ransomed (and so occurring under 06299)
H6302.def: passive participle of «06299». ransomed (and so occurring under «06299»); as abstractly (in plural masculine) a ransom:--(that are) to be (that were) redeemed.

H6303.def: from «06299»; ransom; Padon, one of the Nethinim. -- Padon.

H6304.def: or pduth {ped-ooth'}; from «06929»; distinction; also deliverance:--division, redeem, redemption.

H6305.def: or Pdayahuw {ped-aw-yaw'-hoo}; from «06299» and «03050»; Jah has ransomed; Pedajah, the name of six Israelites:--Pedaiah.

H6306.def: or pidyom {pid-yome'}; also pidyown {pid-yone'}; or pidyon {pid-yone'}; from «06299»; a ransom; --ransom, that were redeemed, redemption.

H6307.et: from an unused root meaning to extend
H6307.def: from an unused root meaning to extend; a plateau; or Paddan pAram {pad-dan' ar-awm'}; from the same and «0758»; the table-land of Aram; Paddan or Paddan-Aram, a region of Syria:--Padan, Padan-aram.

H6309.et: from an unused root meaning to be greasy
H6309.def: from an unused root meaning to be greasy; suet:--fat.

H6310.def: from «06284»; the mouth (as the means of blowing), whether literal or figurative (particularly speech); specifically edge, portion or side; adverbially (with preposition) according to:--accord(-ing as, -ing to), after, appointment, assent, collar, command(-ment), × eat, edge, end, entry, + file, hole, × in, mind, mouth, part, portion, × (should) say(-ing), sentence, skirt, sound, speech, × spoken, talk, tenor, × to, + two-edged, wish, word.

H6311.et: probably from a primitive inseparable particle "p" (of demonstrative force) and (1931)
H6311.def: or «0po6» (Job 38:11) {po}; or pow {po}; probably from a primitive inseparable particle "p" (of demonstrative force) and «01931»; this place (French ici), i.e. here or hence:--here, hither, the one (other, this, that) side.

H6312.def: or Puvvah {poov-vaw'}; from «06284»; a blast; Puah or Puvvah, the name of two Israelites:--Phuvah, Pua, Puah.

H6313.def: a primitive root; to be sluggish:--cease, be feeble, faint, be slacked.

H6315.def: a primitive root; to puff, i.e. blow with the breath or air; hence, to fan (as a breeze), to utter, to kindle (a fire), to scoff:--blow (upon), break, puff, bring into a snare, speak, utter.

H6316.def: of foreign origin; Put, a son of Ham, also the name of his descendants or their region, and of a Persian tribe:--Phut, Put.

H6317.et: from an unused root (probably meaning to disparage) and (0410)
H6317.def: from an unused root (probably meaning to disparage) and «0410»; contempt of God; Putiel, an Israelite:--Putiel.

H6318.def: of Egyptian derivation: Potiphar, an Egyptian:--Potiphar.

H6319.def: of Egyptian derivation; Poti-Phera, an Egyptian:--Poti-pherah.

H6320.et: from an unused root meaning to paint
H6320.def: from an unused root meaning to paint; dye (specifically, stibium for the eyes):--fair colours, glistering, paint(-ed) (-ing).

H6321.et: from an unused root meaning to be thick
H6321.def: from an unused root meaning to be thick; a bean (as plump):--beans.

H6322.def: of foreign origin; Pul, the name of an Assyrian king and of an Ethiopian tribe:--Pul.

H6323.et: a primitive root meaning to turn, i.e. be perplexed
H6323.def: a primitive root meaning to turn, i.e. be perplexed:--be distracted.

H6324.et: patronymically from an unused name meaning a turn
H6324.def: patronymically from an unused name meaning a turn; a Punite (collectively) or descendants of an unknown Pun:--Punites.

H6325.def: from «06323»; perplexity; Punon, a place in the Desert:--Punon.

H6326.et: from an unused root meaning to glitter
H6326.def: from an unused root meaning to glitter; brilliancy; Puah, an Israelitess:--Puah.

H6327.def: a primitive root; to dash in pieces, literally or figuratively (especially to disperse):--break (dash, shake) in (to) pieces, cast (abroad), disperse (selves), drive, retire, scatter (abroad), spread abroad.

H6328.def: a primitive root; to waver:--stumble, move.

H6329.et: a primitive root [identical with (06328) through the idea of dropping out
H6329.def: a primitive root (identical with «06328» through the idea of dropping out; compare «05312»); to issue, i.e. furnish; causatively, to secure; figuratively, to succeed:--afford, draw out, further, get, obtain.

H6331.def: a primitive root; to crush:--break, bring to nought, × utterly take.

H6332.def: also (plural) Puwriym {poo-reem'}; or Puriym {poo-reem'}; from «06331»; a lot (as by means of a broken piece):--Pur, Purim.

H6333.def: from «06331»; a wine-press (as crushing the grapes):--winepress.

H6334.def: of Persian origin; Poratha, a son of Haman:--Poratha.

H6335.def: a primitive root; to spread; figuratively, act proudly:--grow up, be grown fat, spread selves, be scattered.

H6336.et: patronymically from an unused name meaning a hinge
H6336.def: patronymically from an unused name meaning a hinge; a Puthite (collectively) or descendants of an unknown Puth:--Puhites (as if from «06312»).

H6337.def: from «06338»; pure (gold); hence, gold itself (as refined):--fine (pure) gold.

H6339.def: a primitive root (identical with «06338»); to solidify (as if by refining); also to spring (as if separating the limbs):--leap, be made strong.

H6340.def: a primitive root; to scatter, whether in enmity or bounty:--disperse, scatter (abroad).

H6341.def: from «06351»; a (metallic) sheet (as pounded thin); also a spring net (as spread out like a lamina):--gin, (thin) plate, snare.

H6342.def: a primitive root; to be startled (by a sudden alarm); hence, to fear in general:--be afraid, stand in awe, (be in) fear, make to shake.

H6343.def: from «06342»; a (sudden) alarm (properly, the object feared, by implication, the feeling):--dread(-ful), fear, (thing) great (fear, -ly feared), terror.

H6344.def: the same as «06343»; a testicle (as a cause of shame akin to fear):--stone.

H6346.def: of foreign origin; a prefect (of a city or small district):--captain, deputy, governor.

H6348.def: a primitive root; to bubble up or froth (as boiling water), i.e. (figuratively) to be unimportant:--light.

H6351.def: a primitive root; to batter out; but used only as denominative from «06341», to spread a net:--be snared.

H6352.et: perhaps from an unused root probably meaning to be black
H6352.def: perhaps from an unused root probably meaning to be black; a coal, whether charred or live:--coals.

H6353.et: from an unused root probably meaning to fashion
H6353.def: (Aramaic) from an unused root probably meaning to fashion; a potter:--potter.

H6354.et: probably from an unused root apparently meaning to dig
H6354.def: probably from an unused root apparently meaning to dig; a pit, especially for catching animals:--hole, pit, snare.

H6355.def: from «06354» and «04124»; pit of Moab; Pachath-Moab, an Israelite:--Pahath-moab.

H6356.def: from the same as «06354»; a hole (by mildew in a garment):--fret inward.

H6357.def: of foreign derivation; a gem, probably the topaz:--topaz.

H6358.def: passive participle of «06362»; opened, i.e. (as noun) a bud:--open.

H6360.et: intensively from an unused root meaning to pound
H6360.def: intensively from an unused root meaning to pound; a hammer:--hammer.

H6361.et: from a root corresponding to that of (06360)
H6361.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to that of «06360»; a gown (as if hammered out wide):--hose.

H6362.def: a primitive root; to cleave or burst through, i.e. (causatively) to emit, whether literal or figurative (gape):--dismiss, free, let (shoot) out, slip away.

H6363.def: or pitrah {pit-raw'}; from «06362»; a fissure, i.e. (concretely) firstling (as opening the matrix):--firstling, openeth, such as open.

H6364.def: of Egyptian origin; Pi-Beseth, a place in Egypt:--Pi-beseth.

H6365.et: from an unused root probably meaning to pierce
H6365.def: from an unused root probably meaning to pierce; (figuratively) misfortune:--destruction, ruin.

H6366.def: or piyah {pee-yaw'}; feminine of «06310»; an edge:-- (two-)edge(-d).

H6367.et: from (06310) and the fem. pl. of a noun (from the same root as (02356)), with the article interpolated
H6367.def: from «06310» and the feminine plural of a noun (from the same root as «02356»), with the article interpolated; mouth of the gorges; Pi-ha-Chiroth, a place in Egypt: --Pi-hahiroth. (In Numbers 14:19 without Pi-.)

H6368.def: from «06315»; a powder (as easily puffed away), i.e. ashes or dust:--ashes.

H6369.def: apparently from «06310» and «03605»; mouth of all; Picol, a Philistine:--Phichol.

H6370.def: or pilegesh {pee-leh'-ghesh}; of uncertain derivation; a concubine; also (masculine) a paramour:--concubine, paramour.

H6371.et: probably from an unused root meaning to be plump
H6371.def: probably from an unused root meaning to be plump; obesity:--collops.

H6372.et: apparently from (06310) and a variation of (05175)
H6372.def: apparently from «06310» and a variation of «05175»; mouth of a serpent; Pinechas, the name of three Israelites:--Phinehas.

H6373.def: probably the same as «06325»; Pinon, an Idumaean:--Pinon.

H6374.def: for «06366»; an edge or tooth:--tooth, × two-edged.

H6376.def: from «06335»; dispersive; Pishon, a river of Eden:--Pison.

H6377.def: probably from the same as «06596»; expansive; Pithon, an Israelite:--Pithon.

H6378.def: from «06379»; a flask (from which a liquid may flow):--box, vial.

H6379.def: a primitive root; to pour:--run out.

H6380.et: from the act. part. (of the same form as the first word) fem. of an unused root (meaning to entrap) and pl. of (06643)
H6380.def: from the active participle (of the same form as the first word) feminine of an unused root (meaning to entrap) and plural of «06643»; trap of gazelles; Pokereth-Tsebajim, one of the "servants of Solomon":--Pochereth of Zebaim.

H6381.def: a primitive root; properly, perhaps to separate, i.e. distinguish (literally or figuratively); by implication, to be (causatively, make) great, difficult, wonderful:--accomplish, (arise...too, be too) hard, hidden, things too high, (be, do, do a, shew) marvelous(-ly, -els, things, work), miracles, perform, separate, make singular, (be, great, make) wonderful(-ers, -ly, things, works), wondrous (things, works, -ly).

H6384.def: patronymically from «06396»; a Palluite (collectively) or descendants of Pallu:--Palluites.

H6385.def: a primitive root; to split (literally or figuratively):--divide.

H6388.def: from «06385»; a rill (i.e. small channel of water, as in irrigation):--river, stream.

H6389.def: the same as «06388»; earthquake; Peleg, a son of Shem:--Peleg.

H6390.def: from «06385»; a runlet, i.e. gully:--division, river.

H6393.et: from an unused root meaning to divide
H6393.def: from an unused root meaning to divide; a cleaver, i.e. iron armature (of a chariot):--torch.

H6394.def: of uncertain derivation; Pildash, a relative of Abraham:--Pildash.

H6395.def: a primitive root; to distinguish (literally or figuratively):--put a difference, show marvellous, separate, set apart, sever, make wonderfully.

H6396.def: from «06395»; distinguished; Pallu, an Israelite:--Pallu, Phallu.

H6397.et: patronymically from an unused name (from (06395)) meaning separate
H6397.def: patronymically from an unused name (from «06395») meaning separate; a Pelonite or inhabitant of an unknown Palon:-- Pelonite.

H6398.def: a primitive root; to slice, i.e. break open or pierce:--bring forth, cleave, cut, shred, strike through.

H6399.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «06398»; to serve or worship:--minister, serve.
